description.zh: 亮斑在翻涌，黑子较暗，日珥沿弧线伸出。太阳的能量来自深处的核聚变。
description.en: Bright granules evolve, sunspots are darker, and prominences arch above the limb. Nuclear fusion deep inside powers the Sun.

text.zh: 太阳自己发光，周围的行星反射它的光。
text.en: The Sun emits its own light; planets reflect it.

text.zh: 稀薄的外层大气向太空伸展。日珥是受磁场约束的等离子体。
text.en: The thin outer atmosphere extends into space. Magnetic fields support the plasma in prominences.

text.zh: 明暗颗粒与对流有关；黑子比周围冷，却依然非常热。
text.en: Granulation is associated with convection. Sunspots are cooler than their surroundings but still extremely hot.

text.zh: 这里没有坚实地面。我们停在可见光主要发出的光球上方。
text.en: There is no solid ground. We stop above the photosphere, where most visible sunlight escapes.

title.en: A cratered world without a blue sky

description.zh: 靠近灰色岩石，寻找圆形撞击坑的边缘。
description.en: Approach gray rock and look for the raised rims of impact craters.

text.zh: 我们从太空靠近水星。
text.en: We approach Mercury from space.

text.zh: 几乎没有大气散射出蓝天。
text.en: There is almost no atmosphere to scatter a blue sky.

text.zh: 撞击坑的边缘隆起，坑里有阴影。
text.en: Impact rims rise above the ground and cast shadows.

text.zh: 代表性地貌里有岩石与碎屑；这里不是某个实测着陆点。
text.en: This representative terrain has rock and debris; it is not a surveyed landing site.

description.zh: 整球的亮色来自厚云，云下面仍有岩石平原和火山地形。
description.en: Bright clouds cover the globe; beneath them are rocky plains and volcanic terrain.

text.zh: 可见光下，厚云遮住地面。
text.en: Visible light reveals clouds that hide the ground.

text.zh: 雾越来越浓，远处难以看清。
text.en: Haze thickens and limits the view.

text.zh: 穿过云层后，仍有浓厚的大气。
text.en: Below the clouds, a dense atmosphere remains.

text.zh: 地貌参考雷达与着陆影像重建，并非真实下降录像。
text.en: Terrain is reconstructed from radar and landing evidence, not a filmed descent.

title.zh: 流动的云与不同的地貌

description.zh: 云系随大气运动和变化；海洋与大陆不是跟着云一起移动的。
description.en: Cloud systems move and evolve with the atmosphere while oceans and continents remain beneath them.

text.zh: 从太空能分清大陆、海洋和白云。
text.en: From space we can distinguish land, oceans and clouds.

text.zh: 大气边缘出现薄薄的蓝色光晕。
text.en: A thin blue glow appears along the atmospheric limb.

text.zh: 云随风移动，遮住又露出下面的景色。
text.en: Winds carry clouds across the landscape below.

text.zh: 沿同一观察地点接近地面，沙漠与冰盖各有不同的细节。
text.en: Approach the same selected location: desert and ice-sheet sites have different details.

title.zh: 红色沙尘中的岩石世界
title.en: A rocky world in reddish dust

description.zh: 寻找台地、沙纹和岩块。红色并不是燃烧的火。
description.en: Look for mesas, ripples and rocks. The reddish color is not fire.

text.zh: 火星有深浅不同的地表区域。
text.en: Mars has light and dark surface regions.

text.zh: 稀薄大气中的尘埃影响天空颜色。
text.en: Dust in its thin atmosphere affects the sky color.

text.zh: 代表性台地和低地逐渐展开。
text.en: Representative mesas and lowlands come into view.

text.zh: 近景表现沙纹、层状岩石和碎块。
text.en: The close view shows sand ripples, layered rock and fragments.

title.en: Bands and storms in an atmosphere

description.zh: 相邻云带有不同的流动，巨大旋涡持续转动；它们都不是大陆。
description.en: Neighboring cloud bands have different flows and a large vortex circulates. These are not continents.

text.zh: 条纹来自大气里的云带。
text.en: The stripes are atmospheric cloud bands.

text.zh: 云带沿不同方向流动，红斑是巨大风暴。
text.en: Bands flow in different directions; the red spot is a giant storm.

text.zh: 眼前越来越多是云与雾。
text.en: Clouds and haze increasingly fill the view.

text.zh: 没有可站立的地面。继续深入，压力和温度会越来越高。
text.en: There is no ground to stand on. Pressure and temperature rise farther inward.

title.zh: 环外有卫星，环内是巨行星
title.en: Moons beyond rings around a giant

description.zh: 云带围着星球，环在星球外面；卫星沿各自轨道绕行。
description.en: Cloud bands encircle the planet, rings lie outside it, and moons follow their own orbits.

text.zh: 环由许多颗粒组成，不是坚固圆盘。
text.en: Rings consist of many particles, not a solid disc.

text.zh: 我们朝星球靠近，没有在环上着陆。
text.en: We approach the planet without landing on the rings.

text.zh: 浅色云带逐渐充满视野。
text.en: Pale cloud bands gradually fill the view.

text.zh: 土星也没有岩石着陆面；深入只会遇到更高压力。
text.en: Saturn has no rocky landing surface; going deeper leads to greater pressure.

title.zh: 侧身旋转的淡青色世界
title.en: A pale cyan world on its side

description.zh: 淡色外观下也有云和风；冰巨行星不是一颗裸露的冰球。
description.en: Clouds and winds exist beneath its pale appearance. An ice giant is not an exposed ball of ice.

text.zh: 天王星的自转轴倾斜得很厉害。
text.en: Uranus has an extreme axial tilt.

text.zh: 甲烷影响它的可见光颜色。
text.en: Methane affects its visible color.

text.zh: 微弱云纹帮助我们发现大气的运动。
text.en: Subtle streaks help reveal atmospheric motion.

text.zh: 这里没有可踩的冰壳；深处材料的混合方式仍有不确定性。
text.en: There is no icy crust to stand on; the mixture of deep materials remains uncertain.

description.zh: 亮云随着大气运动；蓝色并不说明下面是可以看见的水海洋。
description.en: Bright clouds move with the atmosphere. Blue color does not imply an exposed water ocean.

text.zh: 颜色示意采用较淡的蓝绿色。
text.en: The illustration uses a relatively pale blue-green color.

text.zh: 亮云与较暗云层形成对比。
text.en: Bright clouds contrast with darker layers.

text.zh: 云带运动被加快，方便观察。
text.en: Cloud motion is accelerated for observation.

text.zh: 没有海面或冰地面可着陆；内部需要依靠物理模型推断。
text.en: There is no exposed sea or icy landing ground; interior structure is inferred from models.

description.zh: 月海是较暗的古老熔岩平原；这里的重点是卫星与地貌，月相可以另行探索。
description.en: Maria are darker ancient lava plains. Here we explore the satellite and its terrain; phases have their own topic.

text.zh: 月球绕地球运行，也随地球一起绕太阳。
text.en: The Moon orbits Earth and accompanies it around the Sun.

text.zh: 没有浓厚的大气挡住视线。
text.en: No thick atmosphere obscures the view.

text.zh: 撞击坑与较暗平原形态不同。
text.en: Impact craters differ from the darker plains.

text.zh: 近景是代表性撞击地貌，不是阿波罗着陆点复原。
text.en: This is representative impact terrain, not an Apollo landing reconstruction.

title.zh: 雾下面有冰陆地与甲烷湖
title.en: Icy land and methane lakes beneath haze

description.zh: 这是一颗土星的卫星。湖里的液体主要是甲烷和乙烷，不是地球的水。
description.en: This moon belongs to Saturn. Its lakes contain mainly methane and ethane, not liquid water.

text.zh: 浓雾遮住土卫六的地貌。
text.en: Thick haze hides Titan’s terrain.

text.zh: 大气使远处景物逐渐模糊。
text.en: Atmosphere makes distant features increasingly hazy.

text.zh: 极区有探测器发现的湖海。
text.en: Spacecraft have detected lakes and seas in polar regions.

text.zh: 这里代表一处极区湖岸，不是惠更斯号着陆地点。
text.en: This represents a polar lakeshore, not the Huygens landing site.
